## Workload

Tomas Brennan completed 1024 reads during 480 rostered hours. The recorded rate was 2.1 reads per hour. This provides a summary of the grader’s reported workload for the review period. The workload figure and hourly rate are presented together to support consideration of the volume completed against the time recorded.

## Quality

A sample of 75 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 56.0 per cent. This result should be considered alongside the checked sample and the overall workload reported above.

Priya Anand reviewed the record. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with the aim of supporting consistent grading and identifying areas for further review.
